newsitem.title: USA: Amoco, Shell near deal on Permian venture.
newsitem.headline: Amoco, Shell near deal on Permian venture.

text.p: Amoco Corp Chairman Laurance Fuller on Wednesday said the company is near agreement with Shell Oil Co on a joint venture in the Permian Basin.

Executives of the two companies plan to meet Monday to iron out the final details of the venture, which would manage their exploration and production operations in the west Texas and east New Mexico field.
"I have no reason to believe that that won't come together in the near future," Fuller told reporters after a speech at Cambridge Energy Research Associates annual energy forum in Houston.
Talks on the venture, to be called Altura Energy, stalled last November over undisclosed issues but then were revived late last year.
The venture would form the country's third largest independent oil and gas company, and is part of a wave of alliances being formed as oil companies seek to cut operating costs.
Shell is the domestic unit of Royal Dutch/Shell Group.
